title: Sumerian King List with kings ruling tens of thousands of years

tellings.quote: So you have people that are kings that live 40,000 years plus and you have eight kings that are documented and some of them are real.

plain: An ancient record from Sumer, in old Mesopotamia, known as the Sumerian King List, names kings who are said to have ruled for 40,000 years or more. The comedian and podcaster Joe Rogan raises it with Michels as something he has been told, saying that eight kings are recorded and that some of them were real people. If the list is taken at its word, people once lived and reigned for spans far beyond any human lifetime.
